identity.tone: Deep theta, shadow-lucid, inward-facing, symbolically liminal
identity.shape: A grounded low dyad beneath a narrow crown-light and slowly moving etheric wind
identity.intention: Support deep meditation, dreamwork, shadow-oriented reflection, and imaginative threshold practice
identity.arrival_signature: The 108/114.66 protected dyad settles over 54 Hz, then 144 and 396 establish the chamber before the 963 light begins to move
identity.return_signature: 963 motion stops first, 396 and 144 recede, the dyad resolves into 54 Hz, then the wind closes
must_avoid: presenting pineal or third-eye activation as established biology
using the profile as background audio by default

claims.label: implementation-task
claims.text: 108 Hz left and 114.66 Hz right create a 6.66 Hz binaural difference over headphones.

claims.label: active-research
claims.text: Research on binaural-beat entrainment and specific psychological effects is mixed and methodologically heterogeneous.

claims.label: symbolic-canon
claims.text: 963 Hz carries the veil-crown or third-eye symbol in this protocol.

claims.label: subjective-intention
claims.text: Pineal activation, dimensional perception, and vision beyond the veil are preserved as ritual intentions rather than physiological guarantees.
claims.source_language: stimulate the pineal gland, awaken your third eye, and unlock vision beyond the veil
